atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for USDJPY (RANGE_SPECIALIST). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=3.458, trend_persistence=0.266, mean_reversion=0.734. Learned timeframe weights: M30 (w=+0.281), H1 (w=+0.269), M15 (w=+0.214). Ablation-retained features: liquidity_sweep (w=+0.422), ema_trend (w=+0.185), rsi_momentum (w=+0.167), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.144) (pruned/left out by ablation: fvg_impulse).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for USDJPY (RANGE_SPECIALIST): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=3.458, mean-reversion=0.734). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to M30 (w=+0.281), H1 (w=+0.269), M15 (w=+0.214). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [liquidity_sweep (w=+0.422), ema_trend (w=+0.185), rsi_momentum (w=+0.167), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.144)] and pruned [fvg_impulse].
